artboards.title: Inbox · All
artboards.journey: Inbox root (also the phone on the Start-here entry map)
artboards.what_it_shows: One list mixing P2P chats, paid DMs with countdown, community rooms, money requests and a WAWU system thread, with filter chips All / Paid DMs / Communities / Money. Tab bar is Home · Explore · Inbox · Wallet · Me, with an unread badge on Inbox.
user_actions: compose a new message or community
data_needed: unified thread list across DMs, P2P chats, communities, money events and system notifications, newest first
per-row last-message preview, timestamp, unread count
per-row money signal (money in, paid DM waiting with hours left, request amount + memo)
total unread for the tab badge
paid-DM count for the chip (creator: awaiting replies)

evidence: GET /api/hub/dm/threads (sender side) and GET /api/hub/dm/inbox (creator only, CreatorAccountGuard)
backend.gap: No unified inbox/feed endpoint; no free user-to-user chat model (models searched: only DirectMessage, CommunityMessage, LegalChatMessage); no money-in-chat events; no unread/last-read state on DirectMessage or CommunityMessage; no "my communities" list; no per-thread last-message preview for communities. No real-time transport exists: grep of wawu-backend/src and package.json for WebSocketGateway|@SubscribeMessage|socket.io|@Sse|text/event-stream returned nothing; only @nestjs/schedule cron jobs run server-side. Web fetches once on mount (no setInterval/EventSource/WebSocket in src/lib or src/components messaging code).

web.delta: Web /messages is the CREATOR-only paid-DM inbox ("This inbox is for creators"; fans are sent to /purchases). Communities are a separate bottom-nav slot (/communities). No chips, no P2P chats, no money rows, no WAWU system row. Nav is Home · Communities · Explore · Messages · Settings.

third_party: real-time transport (WebSocket) for live list updates
push provider (FCM/APNs or Expo) for unread badge when backgrounded
facts_on_canvas: Chidi Eze "Paid DM · 18h left to reply"
conflicts: navigation: tab bar Home · Explore · Inbox · Wallet · Me vs current Home · Communities · Explore · Messages · Settings

summary: Inbox replaces the Messages tab and absorbs four things: paid DMs (fan and creator sides, same mechanics for professionals), a new free user-to-user chat with money send/request bubbles, Communities with WAWU Credits (moved out of the tab bar into a chip), and a WAWU system row. The paid-DM engine (send, 24h-default window, respond, expiry sweep, Flutterwave refund executor, settings) and the community/credits engine (rooms, join requests, 1-credit atomic debit, 85% host share) are real and largely served, but every payment on these boards is "Pay from wallet" with a PIN, while the backend charges and refunds through Flutterwave and only creators have a wallet. Free chat, P2P send/request money, a unified inbox feed, unread state, community slugs and "my communities" do not exist in the backend; the no-response penalty is modelled but never computed or enforced, and host credit earnings never reach a wallet. There is no real-time transport at all (no WebSocket/SSE, only cron) and no device-token storage or push provider, so live chat, delivery receipts and mobile push are greenfield. Web /messages is a creator-only paid inbox and Communities is its own nav slot, so the web differs structurally. The biggest risk is custody: "Held by WAWU" and fan-to-fan wallet transfers contradict the current rule that WAWU never holds money, the one line the product rules say must be raised before building. No designer warnings (⚠) appear on the Inbox board.
